summary: Deadpool entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Deadpool
entries.definitive_edition: Owned Windows PC release, or owned PS4/Xbox One rerelease as fallback

emulation.notes: Use native PC or owned console release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Owned PC release with compatibility fixes

primary.why: Deadpool is a licensed Activision game with no normal current storefront route. If an owned PC copy is available, Windows is the best capture route; PS4/Xbox One rereleases are useful fallback routes but were also licensed-era releases.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PC copy with compatibility fixes. Record storefront/media provenance, patch, OS, resolution, controller, difficulty, collectibles/upgrades/challenges, and whether PS4/Xbox One or seventh-generation console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if owned and PC is unavailable.
secondary.why: The later console route is convenient for capture but also subject to licensed availability issues.
PC is the fidelity/capture target when available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record media/storefront provenance because the game has been delisted/relisted around licensing windows.
